payload.contentHtml:
Intelligent Chat

Converse naturally with a powerful AI that understands context, remembers your preferences, and provides precise answers.

Desktop Automation

Control your desktop with natural language. Open apps, manage files, schedule tasks — all through simple conversation.

Skills

Equip WuKong with modular skills to handle specialized tasks. Create custom skills or install community-built ones to expand what your assistant can do.

Work Automation

Automate repetitive workflows with natural language. From file management to data processing, let WuKong handle the routine so you can focus on what matters.

Multi-Language

Communicate in any language. WuKong supports seamless multilingual interaction with real-time translation built in.

1

Download

Grab the installer for macOS, Windows, or Linux. Less than 100MB.

2

Configure

Choose your AI provider, set shortcuts, and personalize your assistant.

3

Go

Press your hotkey and start talking. WuKong is ready to help instantly.
